caption: the ringtone that raced - crazy frog's kart war on pc, complete with the anno 2006 chaos.
about: Crazy frog racer 2 (2006) is the kart racer built around the infinitely annoying amphibian: four cups, battle modes, a character roster of frog-verse regulars and enough licensed music to make it a time capsule of 2006. The pc and ps2 versions share the same course design, and the item balance is exactly as mercenary as the franchise deserved.
The windows build is off sale, carried by archive routes - a genuine piece of mid-2000s ephemera.
